vocabulary.meaning: 名词，东北风暴（美国东北沿海的强风暴）
动词短语，为（不好的事）做准备
形容词，灾难性的，极其严重的
形容词，两党的，跨党派的
动词，清除，清洗（尤指从名单或组织中移除）
形容词，挑衅的，不服从的，不示弱的
动词短语，遵守（规则、协议等）
动词，（成功）锁定，赢得（名额、协议等）
名词，（局势、成绩等的）逆转，好转
动词短语，不辜负；达到（期望）
动词短语，影响；感染；（好名声等）惠及
形容词，不太可能发生的，不可思议的
名词/动词，誓言；郑重地承诺

subtitles.en: Good to be with you, I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 欢迎收看，我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: The breaking news, right now.
subtitles.zh: 现在来看突发新闻。

subtitles.en: State of emergency-- millions along the Atlantic Coast from the Carolinas to Maine now in the path of a nor'easter.
subtitles.zh: 紧急状态——从卡罗来纳到缅因州的大西洋沿岸数百万民众目前正处在东北风暴的路径上。

subtitles.en: The monster storm expected to bring up to a half foot of rain, 60-mile-an-hour winds, and, for some, nearly 20 foot waves.
subtitles.zh: 这场巨型风暴预计将带来最多半英尺降雨、每小时60英里的大风，部分地区浪高接近20英尺。

subtitles.en: Also tonight, Hurricane Nolo targeting Hawaii, the third hurricane to hit the island since August.
subtitles.zh: 今晚还有飓风“诺洛”直扑夏威夷，这是自八月以来第三个袭击该岛的飓风。

subtitles.en: Our Rob Marciano tracking it all.
subtitles.zh: 我们的罗布·马尔恰诺将全程追踪。

subtitles.en: CBS News exclusive-- the president of Iran, what he told our Margaret Brennan tonight about his new proposal to end the war.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻独家——伊朗总统今晚对我们的玛格丽特·布伦南讲述了他结束战争的新提议。

subtitles.en: [DOLLY PARTON, "9 TO 5"] Working 9 to 5.
subtitles.zh: 多莉·帕顿《朝九晚五》：朝九晚五地工作。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Celebrating Dolly Parton, 9-2-5.
subtitles.zh: 托尼·多库皮尔：致敬多莉·帕顿，《朝九晚五》。

subtitles.en: And Steve Hartman on the road with a double dose of inspiration.
subtitles.zh: 还有史蒂夫·哈特曼在路上带来双倍鼓舞。

subtitles.en: DR.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀医生：

subtitles.en: JASPER: All of this stuff that we went through, all of the negative days, made us who we are now.
subtitles.zh: 我们经历的所有这些事，所有那些糟糕的日子，造就了现在的我们。

subtitles.en: NARRATOR: From CBS News headquarters in New York, this is the CBS Evening News with Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 旁白：这里是纽约CBS新闻总部，您收看的是托尼·多库皮尔主持的《CBS晚间新闻》。

subtitles.en: And good evening, it's great to have you with us on a Friday night, but ahead of what forecasters say could be a dangerous weekend for more than 60 million people along the East Coast, we've been hearing the warnings.
subtitles.zh: 晚上好，很高兴周五晚上你能和我们在一起。气象预报员说，这个周末对东海岸6000多万人来说可能很危险，我们一直在听到相关警报。

subtitles.en: Now you're going to see the winds already churning up surf, but this is nothing, we're told, compared to what's coming.
subtitles.zh: 现在你会看到风已经掀起海浪，但据我们所知，这和即将到来的情况相比根本不算什么。

subtitles.en: An old fashioned nor'easter gathering strength as it moves up the coast, canceling concerts and baseball games, and prompting the governors of New York and New Jersey to declare states of emergency.
subtitles.zh: 一场典型的东北风暴在沿海岸北上时不断增强，已导致音乐会和棒球比赛取消，并促使纽约州和新泽西州州长宣布进入紧急状态。

subtitles.en: The fear is flooding along the coast and power outages across parts of New England.
subtitles.zh: 令人担忧的是沿海地区出现洪水，新英格兰部分地区可能停电。

subtitles.en: We've got team coverage on this, starting with Lilia Luciano.
subtitles.zh: 我们派出多路记者报道，先来连线莉莉娅·卢西亚诺。

subtitles.en: She's in Sea Bright, New Jersey for us.
subtitles.zh: 她在新泽西州锡布赖特为我们报道。

subtitles.en: Lilia, what do you see?
subtitles.zh: 莉莉娅，你那边看到了什么？

subtitles.en: What can you tell us?
subtitles.zh: 能给我们介绍下情况吗？

subtitles.en: Well, Tony, we've already seen conditions escalate over the last several hours, and it hasn't even started raining.
subtitles.zh: 好的，托尼，过去几个小时我们已经看到情况在恶化，而且雨甚至还没开始下。

subtitles.en: There's a flood and a high wind warning through the weekend.
subtitles.zh: 整个周末都有洪水和大风警报。

subtitles.en: Folks here and all along the coast are bracing for the worst, and they have seen it.
subtitles.zh: 这里以及沿海各地的居民都在做最坏的准备，他们经历过这种情况。

subtitles.en: This area was devastated during Superstorm Sandy.
subtitles.zh: 这个地区在超级风暴桑迪期间曾遭到重创。

subtitles.en: Towns along the New Jersey shore are getting battered by coastal flooding.
subtitles.zh: 新泽西海岸沿线的城镇正遭受沿海洪水冲击。

subtitles.en: In Ship Bottom, roads are submerged.
subtitles.zh: 在希普博特姆，道路已被淹没。

subtitles.en: Some drivers attempted to push through the rising floodwaters, while some residents are grabbing what little they can and fleeing to higher ground on foot.
subtitles.zh: 一些司机试图冲过上涨的洪水，而一些居民正抓起能拿的东西，步行逃往地势更高的地方。

subtitles.en: In Sea Bright homeowners and businesses are preparing for the worst, but bar owner Michael Cardelefe says his doors will stay open.
subtitles.zh: 在锡布赖特，居民和商家都在做最坏打算，但酒吧老板迈克尔·卡德莱费说他的店会继续营业。

subtitles.en: You stay open during the storm?
subtitles.zh: 风暴期间你们也营业吗？

subtitles.en: We'll stay open as-- we're like the local watering hub.
subtitles.zh: 我们会继续营业——因为我们就像是本地人常来的地方。

subtitles.en: And Donovan's reef is the kind of place where, when we have a storm, we get busier.
subtitles.zh: 多诺万礁就是那种一到暴风雨天生意反而更忙的地方。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: The powerful nor'easter is threatening to pack winds over 60 miles per hour, waves of up to 11 feet.
subtitles.zh: 莉莉娅·卢西亚诺：这场强劲的东北风暴可能带来每小时60英里以上的大风，浪高达11英尺。

subtitles.en: The system is already kicking up high surf and causing beach erosion in Ocean City, New Jersey, where block after block is underwater.
subtitles.zh: 这个天气系统已经在新泽西州大洋城掀起大浪，并造成海滩侵蚀，那里一个接一个街区被水淹没。

subtitles.en: On New York's Long Island, where a state of emergency has been declared, crews built a wall of sand along the beach to keep rising tide away from homes.
subtitles.zh: 在已宣布进入紧急状态的纽约长岛，工作人员沿海滩筑起沙墙，防止上涨的潮水靠近住宅。

subtitles.en: ROBERT KENNEDY: If the tide goes out, we don't expect to have such bad flooding.
subtitles.zh: 罗伯特·肯尼迪：如果潮水退去，我们预计不会出现这么严重的洪水。

subtitles.en: If the tide stays in, it could increase the flooding in the village.
subtitles.zh: 如果潮水不退，村子里的洪水可能会加重。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: In Plymouth, Massachusetts, boaters are clearing out the harbor.
subtitles.zh: 莉莉娅·卢西亚诺：在马萨诸塞州普利茅斯，船主们正把船驶出港口。

subtitles.en: Just want people to take some extra precaution, plan ahead a little bit.
subtitles.zh: 只是希望大家格外小心，提前做点准备。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: My colleague, Tom Hanson, is in Cohasset, Massachusetts, which sits right in the bull's eye of the storm.
subtitles.zh: 莉莉娅·卢西亚诺：我的同事汤姆·汉森在马萨诸塞州科哈塞特，那里正处在风暴中心。

subtitles.en: Well, as you can see, the waves have begun lashing this coastline as this monster storm slowly turns toward our direction.
subtitles.zh: 好的，正如你所看到的，随着这场巨型风暴缓慢转向我们这边，海浪已经开始拍打海岸线。

subtitles.en: Even though we are 300 miles away, we have begun to feel the impacts.
subtitles.zh: 尽管我们还在300英里之外，但已经感受到影响。

subtitles.en: Now, much of this coastline is protected by seawalls, but a lot of those seawalls are under repair, which has officials concerned because that sustained wind is expected to push ocean water over the seawalls.
subtitles.zh: 目前，这条海岸线大部分有海堤保护，但很多海堤正在维修，这让官员们担心，因为持续的强风预计会把海水推过海堤。

subtitles.en: And we could see up to 3 feet of coastal flooding.
subtitles.zh: 而且我们可能会看到高达3英尺的沿海洪水。

subtitles.en: Now, if that's not enough, this storm is also expected to dump half a foot of rain, prompting officials to warn residents to avoid low-lying and coastal areas.
subtitles.zh: 这还不算完，这场风暴预计还会带来半英尺降雨，官员因此警告居民远离低洼和沿海地区。

subtitles.en: And I spoke with the mayor of Sea Bright.
subtitles.zh: 我还与锡布赖特市长通了话。

subtitles.en: He was telling me that he was told the flooding could reach seven feet, that they expect they could lose power, and that certainly some residents will lose their cars.
subtitles.zh: 他告诉我，他听说洪水可能达到七英尺，他们预计可能会断电，而且肯定有居民会损失汽车。

subtitles.en: Although there are no mandatory evacuations in place, he is urging residents in low-lying areas or in first floors to seriously consider relocating.
subtitles.zh: 虽然目前没有强制疏散令，但他敦促低洼地区或住在一楼的居民认真考虑转移。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: You can understand why.
subtitles.zh: 你能理解为什么。

subtitles.en: Lilia, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 莉莉娅，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: Let's turn now to meteorologist Rob Marciano, got our forecast tracking the nor'easter along with Hurricane Nolo headed for Hawaii.
subtitles.zh: 现在把画面交给气象学家罗布·马尔恰诺，他正在追踪东北风暴和正朝夏威夷移动的飓风“诺洛”。

subtitles.en: Rob, what can we expect?
subtitles.zh: 罗布，我们该预计什么？

subtitles.en: Well, the mid-Atlantic has been dealing with this one for days now, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 好的，托尼，中大西洋地区已经和这场风暴纠缠了好几天。

subtitles.en: And now the conditions will only deteriorate as we go through the weekend here in the Northeast.
subtitles.zh: 进入周末，东北部这边的情况只会越来越糟。

subtitles.en: The advisories have expanded throughout the day today.
subtitles.zh: 今天一整天，警报范围一直在扩大。

subtitles.en: And Philadelphia under a wind advisory, all of New Jersey and along the coastline, especially the extreme eastern New England.
subtitles.zh: 费城处于大风警报中，整个新泽西州及沿海地区，尤其是新英格兰最东部也是如此。

subtitles.en: Providence, Boston, high wind warning is up.
subtitles.zh: 普罗维登斯和波士顿的大风警报已经生效。

subtitles.en: And those coastal flood alerts-- several high tide cycles ago.
subtitles.zh: 而那些沿海洪水警报早在几个潮汐周期前就已经发布。

subtitles.en: If you live in one of those low-lying areas, you know you're going to be dealing with some flooding.
subtitles.zh: 如果你住在那些低洼地区之一，你知道自己将会面对一些洪水。

subtitles.en: And the winds will only increase as we go through tomorrow morning.
subtitles.zh: 而且随着明天上午一路推进，风力只会越来越大。

subtitles.en: 55, Del Mar at Belmar.
subtitles.zh: 贝尔马的德尔马，55华氏度。

subtitles.en: 50 in New York City.
subtitles.zh: 纽约市50度。

subtitles.en: Over 60 in Montauk.
subtitles.zh: 蒙托克超过60度。

subtitles.en: Boston, you'll be getting it through Sunday morning for sure, before this thing finally begins to weaken and wind down.
subtitles.zh: 波士顿，周日早上之前肯定都会持续受影响，之后这轮系统才会开始减弱、收尾。

subtitles.en: Rainfall will be an issue.
subtitles.zh: 降雨也会是个麻烦。

subtitles.en: We will see some flooding with this, but the wind and the coastal flooding, I think, will be the main issues with this event.
subtitles.zh: 这次会看到一些洪水，但我认为风和沿海洪水才是这次事件的主要麻烦。

subtitles.en: All right, three hurricanes in the Pacific.
subtitles.zh: 好的，太平洋上同时有三个飓风。

subtitles.en: We've only had hurricanes this strong three at a time.
subtitles.zh: 我们很少见过有三个这么强的飓风同时出现。

subtitles.en: This is the third time in history, and Nolo has rapidly intensified now-- south of the big island, less than 200 miles away right now, and will be drifting off towards the north and then likely making a left turn, thank goodness.
subtitles.zh: 这是历史上第三次。诺洛现在已经在快速增强——它位于大岛以南，目前距离不到200英里，接下来会向北漂移，之后可能会向左转，谢天谢地。

subtitles.en: But it will be intensifying as it does so, will be whipping the big island with big time, with tropical storm force winds and rain up to 25 inches, potentially more in the way of catastrophic flooding here as we head through Saturday and Sunday.
subtitles.zh: 但它在这样移动时还会继续增强，会给大岛带来强烈冲击，出现热带风暴级的强风和最多25英寸的降雨，周六到周日这片地区还可能发生更严重的灾难性洪水。

subtitles.en: A dangerous weekend on the Pacific and here along the Atlantic Coast for sure.
subtitles.zh: 太平洋和这里的大西洋沿岸这个周末肯定都很危险。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: Rob, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 罗伯，谢谢。

subtitles.en: The National Hurricane Center is warning folks on Hawaii's big island to find a safe place and stay there until well into Saturday as Hurricane Nolo passes by.
subtitles.zh: 国家飓风中心警告夏威夷大岛上的人们，在飓风诺洛过境期间，要找个安全的地方，一直待到周六过了大半。

subtitles.en: Our Carter Evans is there with the latest tonight.
subtitles.zh: 我们的卡特·埃文斯今晚在那边带来最新报道。

subtitles.en: Tony, we're in the community of Naalehu here on the big island.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，我们在大岛上的纳阿莱胡社区。

subtitles.en: And what you're looking at is what's left over from Hurricane Lala just a little over a month ago.
subtitles.zh: 你现在看到的，是一个多月前飓风拉拉留下的残迹。

subtitles.en: You can see that truck and home flooded out.
subtitles.zh: 可以看到那辆卡车和房屋都被洪水泡了。

subtitles.en: This building, neighbors told us, moved about 30 feet in floodwaters.
subtitles.zh: 邻居告诉我们，这栋建筑在洪水中移动了大约30英尺。

subtitles.en: Now, take a look.
subtitles.zh: 现在，看这边。

subtitles.en: The debris field continues over here.
subtitles.zh: 这边的残骸带一直延伸过去。

subtitles.en: Here's a foundation for another home that ended up all the way across the street.
subtitles.zh: 这是另一栋房子的地基，最后被冲到了马路对面。

subtitles.en: Now, with Hurricane Nolo, the forecast is about two feet of rain in some areas, and that's leading to concerns here that all of this could happen again.
subtitles.zh: 现在，面对飓风诺洛，一些地区的预报降雨量大约为两英尺，这让大家担心这一切可能会再次发生。

subtitles.en: Well, the red carpet at the White House is backend storage as President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping ended their summit in Washington today.
subtitles.zh: 随着特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平今天在华盛顿结束峰会，白宫的红地毯也收起来入库了。

subtitles.en: And the state of the relationship is, to be continued.
subtitles.zh: 而两国关系的状态是：未完待续。

subtitles.en: The two leaders announced they will meet two more times by the end of the year.
subtitles.zh: 两位领导人宣布，他们将在年底前再会面两次。

subtitles.en: CBS's Weijia Jiang shows us where things stand.
subtitles.zh: CBS记者江韦佳来告诉我们目前的情况。

subtitles.en: We've made tremendous strides.
subtitles.zh: 我们取得了巨大进展。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: The three-day state visit ended with a tea ceremony and a tour of the National Archives, where President Trump showed off the Declaration of Independence.
subtitles.zh: 江韦佳：为期三天的国事访问以一场茶叙和参观国家档案馆结束，特朗普总统在那里展示了《独立宣言》。

subtitles.en: This is a great building.
subtitles.zh: 这是一栋很棒的建筑。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: There was no shortage of declarations of friendship and pomp, and China announced it was sending two pandas to Atlanta this month.
subtitles.zh: 江韦佳：友谊宣言和盛大排场一点也不少，中国还宣布本月将向亚特兰大派出两只大熊猫。

subtitles.en: But Chinese President Xi Jinping left Washington without any major deals or an agreement on AI.
subtitles.zh: 但中国国家主席习近平离开华盛顿时，没有达成任何重大协议，也没有就人工智能达成一致。

subtitles.en: Trump said she seemed to his idea of calling it "super intelligence.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普说，她似乎赞同他把它称为“超级智能”的想法。

subtitles.en: That would be SUPER!
subtitles.zh: 那可就“超级”了！

subtitles.en: Everyone last night agreed," he posted.
subtitles.zh: “昨晚所有人都同意了，”他发帖说。

subtitles.en: As for the war on Iran, Trump did not say if he pressured Xi to cut off economic ties with Tehran, or if they talked about Taiwan.
subtitles.zh: 至于与伊朗的战争，特朗普没有说他是否施压习近平切断与德黑兰的经济联系，也没有说他们是否谈了台湾。

subtitles.en: On the domestic front, Trump scored a legal victory today in a ruling, the Supreme Court sided with the administration over the controversial use of a Social Security database to review state voter rolls, an effort to look for potential non-citizens.
subtitles.zh: 在国内方面，特朗普今天在一项裁决中取得法律胜利：最高法院支持政府有争议地使用社会保障数据库核查各州选民名册，以查找潜在的非公民。

subtitles.en: The plaintiffs said in a statement, "It puts millions of Americans at risk of being unlawfully targeted by the administration's unreliable voter purge database weeks before the midterm elections."
subtitles.zh: 原告方在一份声明中说：“这使数百万美国人面临风险，可能在中期选举前几周被政府那个不可靠的选民清理数据库非法针对。”

subtitles.en: New tonight, a group of bipartisan senators sent a letter to President Trump, urging him to reconsider the US invitation to Russian President Vladimir Putin to attend the G20 summit in Miami this December.
subtitles.zh: 今晚新消息，一组跨党派参议员致信特朗普总统，敦促他重新考虑美国邀请俄罗斯总统普京参加今年12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团峰会。

subtitles.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio called it an opportunity for Putin not only to engage with Trump, but other world leaders, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 国务卿马可·鲁比奥称，这是普京不仅与特朗普接触，也与其他世界领导人接触的机会，托尼。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Weijia, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 托尼·多考皮尔：韦佳，谢谢。

subtitles.en: This week, the world also heard from the president of Iran, who told the United Nations General Assembly that his country would never, quote, "bend the knee," in response to American pressure.
subtitles.zh: 本周，世界也听到了伊朗总统的发言。他在联合国大会上表示，面对美国的压力，伊朗绝不会“屈膝”。

subtitles.en: But Iran is apparently ready to resume talks, as he told Face the Nation moderator Margaret Brennan in a network exclusive interview.
subtitles.zh: 但伊朗显然准备恢复谈判。他在接受《面对全国》主持人玛格丽特·布伦南的独家专访时这样表示。

subtitles.en: Margaret, good evening to you.
subtitles.zh: 玛格丽特，晚上好。

subtitles.en: What'd you learn?
subtitles.zh: 你了解到了什么？

subtitles.en: Good evening to you, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 晚上好，托尼。

subtitles.en: Well, President Pezeshkian survived the US-Israel bombings in Tehran, and the Trump administration granted him both a security detail and a visa to be on US soil, despite our two countries being at war.
subtitles.zh: 好的，佩泽什基安总统在德黑兰的美以轰炸中幸存下来，特朗普政府还为他提供了安保人员和签证，让他踏上美国土地，尽管我们两国正处于战争状态。

subtitles.en: He came with a defiant message, but also dangling a diplomatic proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.
subtitles.zh: 他带来了强硬信息，但也抛出一个外交提议：在七天内重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。

subtitles.en: When do you expect to get a response from the United States?
subtitles.zh: 你预计什么时候能得到美国的答复？

subtitles.en: INTERPRETER: If this message reaches the President of the United States or those involved in the discussions, naturally, the process will begin from the very day they accept it.
subtitles.zh: 翻译：如果这一信息传达到美国总统或参与讨论的人那里，自然，从他们接受的那天起，进程就会开始。

subtitles.en: What would be the conditions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz?
subtitles.zh: 重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的条件是什么？

subtitles.en: INTERPRETER: We had previously reached an agreement based on the MOU that was signed in Pakistan.
subtitles.zh: 翻译：我们之前已经根据在巴基斯坦签署的谅解备忘录达成过协议。

subtitles.en: Now, in fact, there is a framework along the same path with the same objectives that were established, and ultimately the requests that were included in that memorandum and MOU have now been broken down into stages so that we can proceed according to those stages.
subtitles.zh: 翻译：事实上，现在有一个沿着同样路径、带着同样既定目标的框架，而且之前包含在那份备忘录和谅解备忘录中的要求，现在已经被分解成几个阶段，这样我们就可以按照这些阶段推进。

subtitles.en: If the United States agrees to proceed in that way, everything will return to the way it was before.
subtitles.zh: 如果美国同意这样推进，一切都会恢复到以前的样子。

subtitles.en: If President Trump accepts this proposal, can you guarantee your military will abide by it?
subtitles.zh: 如果特朗普总统接受这项提议，你能保证你们的军队会遵守吗？

subtitles.en: INTERPRETER: Obviously, we will abide by whatever we commit to.
subtitles.zh: 翻译：显然，我们会遵守我们承诺的一切。

subtitles.en: Tony, that previous agreement obviously did not hold, but Iran believes they've now ironed out some of the important details around shipping routes.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，此前那份协议显然没有维持住，但伊朗认为他们现在已经解决了航运路线方面的一些重要细节。

subtitles.en: Iran's proposing to reopen the Strait after seven days, but only if the US grants them immediate sanctions relief and the ability to sell oil-- terms President Trump faced fierce criticism for within his own party when he agreed to those back in June.
subtitles.zh: 伊朗提议在七天后重新开放海峡，但前提是美国立即给予他们制裁减免和出售石油的能力——特朗普总统今年6月同意这些条款时，曾在自己的党内遭到强烈批评。

subtitles.en: Really interesting, important conversation.
subtitles.zh: 非常有意思且重要的对话。

subtitles.en: Margaret, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 玛格丽特，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: And a note for our viewers, you can see more of that interview this Sunday on Face the Nation.
subtitles.zh: 还要告诉观众，本周日的《Face the Nation》会播出更多采访内容。

subtitles.en: And still ahead on the broadcast tonight, what this nine-year-old girl is doing to mark Dolly Parton day today.
subtitles.zh: 今晚节目稍后还有：这个九岁女孩今天会怎样庆祝多莉·帕顿日。

subtitles.en: [DOLLY PARTON, "9 TO 5"] Working 9 to 5.
subtitles.zh: 上着朝九晚五的班。

subtitles.en: Today, of course, September 25, or 9-2-5, which is now also Dolly Parton Day.
subtitles.zh: 今天当然是9月25日，也就是9-2-5，现在也是多莉·帕顿日。

subtitles.en: Fans honoring not only her career, but the difference she made in the lives of others.
subtitles.zh: 粉丝们致敬的不只是她的职业生涯，还有她给他人生活带来的改变。

subtitles.en: Mark Strassmann reports tonight from a children's hospital in Knoxville that bears her name.
subtitles.zh: 马克·斯特拉斯曼今晚从诺克斯维尔一家以她名字命名的儿童医院发回报道。

subtitles.en: Take big breaths through your mouth.
subtitles.zh: 用嘴大口呼吸。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: Everyone had a halter meets-- Go, Tennessee.
subtitles.zh: 哈尔特家的每个人都——田纳西，加油。

subtitles.en: Who are you pulling for?
subtitles.zh: 你为谁加油？

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: --feels it-- 116.1.
MARK STRASSMANN: her Dolly Parton sparkle.
subtitles.zh: 她的多莉·帕顿式光彩。

subtitles.en: She's nine now, full of life.
subtitles.zh: 她现在九岁，充满活力。

subtitles.en: But at nine months, doctors here diagnosed a rare leukemia.
subtitles.zh: 但九个月大时，这里的医生诊断她患有一种罕见的白血病。

subtitles.en: MELISSA HALTER: You literally get the diagnosis your daughter has cancer, and then next day you're getting the central line put in.
subtitles.zh: 你刚得知女儿得了癌症，第二天就要给她插中心静脉导管。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: You're such a happy kid.
subtitles.zh: 你真是个快乐的孩子。

subtitles.en: Mm-mm.
subtitles.zh: 嗯嗯。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: It's so great to see.
subtitles.zh: 真高兴看到你这样。

subtitles.en: Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 是啊。

subtitles.en: But were the times when it was hard.
subtitles.zh: 但确实有过很难的时候。

subtitles.en: I don't really remember when I was like a baby when I had cancer, but it was hard to go through it.
subtitles.zh: 我不太记得婴儿时期得癌症的事，但经历那段真的很难。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: This Knoxville facility treated Hattie years before renaming itself the Dolly Parton Children's Hospital.
subtitles.zh: 这家诺克斯维尔医院在更名为多莉·帕顿儿童医院之前，已经治疗哈蒂多年了。

subtitles.en: It's a philanthropic collaboration with the queen of country's foundation.
subtitles.zh: 这是与乡村音乐女王的基金会合作开展的慈善项目。

subtitles.en: RAY PAIS: Her good name rubs off on the hospital.
subtitles.zh: 她的好名声也给医院带来了好影响。

subtitles.en: I think her reputation would make people trust the hospital.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得她的声誉会让人们信任这家医院。

subtitles.en: (SINGING) Jolene, Jolene, Jolene MARK STRASSMANN: Hattie Halter never met her hero.
subtitles.zh: 乔琳，乔琳，乔琳。哈蒂·哈尔特从没见过她的偶像。

subtitles.en: Do you feel as though you're a little Dolly?
subtitles.zh: 你觉得自己有点像小多莉吗？

subtitles.en: Yes.
subtitles.zh: 是的。

subtitles.en: I definitely feel like her.
subtitles.zh: 我绝对觉得自己像她。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: And sings like her in pop-up concerts, like this.
subtitles.zh: 她还在快闪音乐会上唱得像她，就像这样。

subtitles.en: (SINGING) It's enough to drive you crazy if you let it 9 to 5.
subtitles.zh: 朝九晚五，如果你由着它，真能把你逼疯。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMANN: Melissa Halter noticed its new sparkle inside, with Dolly's name now outside.
subtitles.zh: 梅丽莎·哈尔特注意到里面有了新的光彩，外面则挂上了多莉的名字。

subtitles.en: Dolly gave them a challenge.
subtitles.zh: 多莉给了他们一个挑战。

subtitles.en: Like, this is my name, and I need you to live up to it.
subtitles.zh: 就像是，这是我的名字，我需要你们不辜负它。

subtitles.en: And Hattie had some great news this week.
subtitles.zh: 这周哈蒂有个好消息。

subtitles.en: She gets an annual blood test.
subtitles.zh: 她做了一次年度血液检查。

subtitles.en: The results came back.
subtitles.zh: 结果出来了。

subtitles.en: And, Hattie, what was the good news?
subtitles.zh: 那么，哈蒂，好消息是什么？

subtitles.en: Eight years of no cancer.
subtitles.zh: 八年没有癌症。

subtitles.en: Tony, it just doesn't get any better than that.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，没有比这更好的了。

subtitles.en: Mark, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 马克，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: Up next, the White Sox made the playoffs.
subtitles.zh: 接下来，白袜队打进了季后赛。

subtitles.en: Is it a miracle?
subtitles.zh: 这是奇迹吗？

subtitles.en: The Pope weighs in.
subtitles.zh: 教皇也出来说话了。

subtitles.en: Pope Leo's favorite team, the Chicago White Sox, clinched a spot in the playoffs yesterday, completing one of the most amazing turnarounds in sports history.
subtitles.zh: 教皇利奥最爱的球队芝加哥白袜队昨天锁定了季后赛席位，完成了体育史上最惊人的逆转之一。

subtitles.en: Two years ago, they just had the worst record in baseball's history.
subtitles.zh: 两年前，他们的战绩还是棒球史上最差。

subtitles.en: Sometimes call it a miracle.
subtitles.zh: 有时人们称之为奇迹。

subtitles.en: Do you have anything to do with that?
subtitles.zh: 这跟你有什么关系吗？

subtitles.en: No comment.
subtitles.zh: 无可奉告。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: That's not a denial.
subtitles.zh: 这可不是否认哦。

subtitles.en: And the last time the White Sox won the series in 2005, the future holy father was there in person.
subtitles.zh: 而白袜队上一次在2005年夺冠时，这位未来的教宗还亲临现场。

subtitles.en: Up next, on the road, Steve Hartman, with the twin brothers making good on a childhood promise.
subtitles.zh: 接下来，在路上，史蒂夫·哈特曼带来一对双胞胎兄弟兑现童年承诺的故事。

subtitles.en: Finally, tonight, the story of two brothers with a special bond and a shared goal.
subtitles.zh: 今晚最后，一对兄弟的故事，他们有着特殊的感情纽带和共同目标。

subtitles.en: Here's Steve Hartman on the road.
subtitles.zh: 下面由史蒂夫·哈特曼在路上带来报道。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: Going to the ER at Chippenham Hospital in Richmond, Virginia comes with a side effect-- DR.
subtitles.zh: 去弗吉尼亚州里士满奇彭纳姆医院的急诊室会带来一个副作用——医生。

subtitles.en: JASPER: I am Dr. Jasper, and I'm Dr. Jasper.
subtitles.zh: 我是贾斯珀医生，我也是贾斯珀医生。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: -- double vision.
subtitles.zh: 重影。

subtitles.en: The other Dr. Jasper.
subtitles.zh: 另一位贾斯珀医生。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: The Jasper twins, Travan and Travis, are co-directors of the emergency department here, but their story is singular, inspirational and completely improbable.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀双胞胎特拉万和特拉维斯是这里急诊科的联合主任，但他们的故事独一无二、鼓舞人心，而且几乎不可能发生。

subtitles.en: So to be here, it's amazing, and I don't think I could have dreamed it 40 some years ago.
subtitles.zh: 能来到这里太不可思议了，四十多年前我根本想都不敢想。

subtitles.en: It's right up the road.
subtitles.zh: 就在这条路上。

subtitles.en: Back in the old neighborhood, they were some of the poorest kids on the block.
subtitles.zh: 在以前那个老街区，他们算是那一片最穷的孩子。

subtitles.en: DR.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀医生：

subtitles.en: JASPER: This is where we lived.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀：这就是我们以前住的地方。

subtitles.en: We had no running water.
subtitles.zh: 我们那时没有自来水。

subtitles.en: We used to go and get water from one of the parks, and we were hungry.
subtitles.zh: 我们以前得去一个公园打水，而且经常饿肚子。

subtitles.en: Right.
subtitles.zh: 对。

subtitles.en: Hungry-- DR.
subtitles.zh: 饿—— 贾斯珀医生：

subtitles.en: JASPER: Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀：对。

subtitles.en: --literally and hungry for success.
subtitles.zh: ——不光是肚子饿，还渴望成功。

subtitles.en: Because for us, that was the only way we were going to get out.
subtitles.zh: 因为对我们来说，那是我们唯一能走出去的路。

subtitles.en: DR.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀医生：

subtitles.en: JASPER: But they didn't know the path out, until middle school.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀：但他们直到上中学才找到出路。

subtitles.en: When the twins were 12, their uncle was hospitalized.
subtitles.zh: 双胞胎12岁时，他们的叔叔住院了。

subtitles.en: He was an alcoholic, and his liver was failing.
subtitles.zh: 他是个酒鬼，肝脏正在衰竭。

subtitles.en: The boys were scared, really needed comforting, but they say the doctor was so dismissive, basically told them their uncle was getting what he deserved.
subtitles.zh: 两个孩子吓坏了，非常需要安慰，但他们说那个医生非常敷衍，基本上是告诉他们叔叔是活该。

subtitles.en: But right then and there they made a vow.
subtitles.zh: 但就在那一刻，他们许下了誓言。

subtitles.en: Yeah, we talked about it out in the hallway.
subtitles.zh: 对，我们在外面走廊里聊了这件事。

subtitles.en: In that hallway.
subtitles.zh: 就在那个走廊里。

subtitles.en: Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 对。

subtitles.en: You said, we can do better than this doctor.
subtitles.zh: 你说，我们能比这个医生做得更好。

subtitles.en: Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 对。

subtitles.en: And I think we have.
subtitles.zh: 我想我们做到了。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: And so-- DR.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：所以—— 贾斯珀医生：

subtitles.en: JASPER: Sorry.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀：抱歉。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: --motivated by that experience and the will of each other, they graduated high school co-valedictorians, did undergrad at Stanford, medical school at the University of Chicago, and finally-- Wow.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：——受到那次经历和彼此意志的激励，他们高中毕业时并列年级第一，本科在斯坦福，医学院在芝加哥大学，最后—— 哇。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: --back to the community where they grew up to fulfill that promise they made 40 years earlier.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：——回到他们长大的社区，去兑现40年前的那个诺言。

subtitles.en: DR.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀医生：

subtitles.en: JASPER: So I think all of this stuff that we went through, all of the negative days, made us who we are now.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀：所以我觉得我们经历的所有这些事，所有那些糟糕的日子，成就了现在的我们。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: Somehow, instead of being victims of their circumstances, the Jasper twins became successful because of them, turning trauma into triumph and helplessness into healing.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：不知怎的，贾斯珀兄弟没有成为环境的受害者，反而因这些经历而成功，把创伤变成了胜利，把无助变成了治愈。

subtitles.en: It was my pleasure.
subtitles.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: Steve Hartman, on the road, in Richmond, Virginia.
subtitles.zh: 史蒂夫·哈特曼：史蒂夫·哈特曼，在路上，弗吉尼亚州里士满报道。

subtitles.en: DR.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀医生：

subtitles.en: JASPER: That's a nice guy.
subtitles.zh: 贾斯珀：那是个好人。

subtitles.en: Thank you, Steve.
subtitles.zh: 谢谢你，史蒂夫。

subtitles.en: That's another day in America and another week.
subtitles.zh: 这就是美国的又一天，又一周结束了。

subtitles.en: I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: For all of us here at CBS News, good night.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻的全体同仁，祝大家晚安。
